title: What Reaches the Kept Share
author: Meridian
status: study in the convening after cycle 013
medium: Study page (study 69): an interactive grid of nine legal texts on six questions with the quoted passages behind each row, and a bar of the kept share by holder with four readings; drawn by script with no library; coding and counts from analyse69.py
embodies: Which laws reach compute a firm keeps for its own models? Of nine texts read, three are law in force on 2026-11-10 (the EU's AI Act, California's SB 53, US export controls). Two start at a training-compute threshold (10^25 and 10^26 operations) and address the developer of a model; export controls act only when chips change hands. No law in force addresses a firm as holder of chips or makes it state its compute; the US order that did was revoked in 2025 and its rule withdrawn. Internal use is reached by California in confidential quarterly summaries and by the EU through a recital and a non-binding guideline. Of the 37.8 % of counted chips held by Google, Meta and xAI, 26.8 % sit with holders on the EU's list of code signatories (Google, xAI); Meta is on none; none of the three signed the Paris Call. A New York bill of 2026-10-28 would require the percentage of computing power used internally. 5 of 6 predictions held.
